name: 5-nitro-DMT
summary: 5-Nitro-DMT (5-nitro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a substituted tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist, though its subtype selectivity has not been studied with modern techniques.

pharmacology.text: 5-Nitro-DMT (5-nitro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a substituted tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist, though its subtype selectivity has not been studied with modern techniques.

uses.text: 5-Nitro-DMT (5-nitro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a substituted tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist, though its subtype selectivity has not been studied with modern techniques.

fact.en: Its nitro group, one nitrogen bonded to two oxygens, is the same group that makes TNT explosive, though here it simply pulls electrons away from the ring.
fact.zh: 它的硝基由一個氮連接兩個氧組成，而這正是讓TNT具有爆炸性的那個基團；不過在這裡，它只是把電子從環上吸走。
fact.zhHans: 它的硝基由一个氮连接两个氧组成，而这正是让TNT具有爆炸性的那个基团；不过在这里，它只是把电子从环上吸走。
